@: Settings > Hardware: the graphics cards and what WardogClips may do with each (web/js/hardware.js).
can.nvidia: Decodes video, reads the HUD text and turns speech into text.
can.integrated: Built-in graphics: decodes video only when no other graphics card is set to Use for WardogClips. HUD text and speech run on another card or on the processor.
can.other: Decodes video and reads the HUD text. Speech turns into text on the processor, because that needs an NVIDIA card.
@can.integrated: "Use for WardogClips" is the name of the role.use option; keep them the same.
none_found: No graphics card was found. WardogClips does all its work on the processor.
all_left_alone: Every card is set to Leave alone, so WardogClips does all its work on the processor.
shared_hint: The card that runs your game is shared: while you play, WardogClips work on it can cost the game a few frames. Set that card to Leave alone if it bothers you.
apply_hint: A change applies to the next job. When you add a card, more video jobs run at once after a restart.
load_failed: The list of graphics cards could not be loaded.
@saved: keys = the names of the changed settings (internal names, not translated).
